SAT Prep Course

Structured, focused preparation to help you raise your SAT score with confidence.

4.8(0)35hFlexibleAll Levels

About this course

This all levels test preparation course offers 35 hours of instruction. By the end, you'll be able to master core strategies for the Reading, Writing, and Math sections; practice with timed, realistic test conditions; identify and strengthen individual weak areas; build pacing and test-day confidence. Every course on TutorA is reviewed by our team before it's published, and every request is matched by a person — not an open marketplace where anyone can pitch you.

Structured to work for both newcomers and learners with prior experience in test preparation.

What you’ll learn

  • Master core strategies for the Reading, Writing, and Math sections
  • Practice with timed, realistic test conditions
  • Identify and strengthen individual weak areas
  • Build pacing and test-day confidence
$35/hr
